name: 3DRef
description: Large-scale 3D reflection detection benchmark with aligned RGB, multi-return LiDAR, semantic labels, and textured 3D ground truth meshes for evaluating reflection-aware perception in indoor environments.
evaluation_method: segmentation and detection metrics such as mIoU, per-class IoU, precision, recall, and F1 score on RGB, LiDAR, or fused inputs
notes: Focuses on reflective surfaces such as glass and mirrors, which are notoriously difficult for both 2D and 3D perception systems. The dataset contains more than 50,000 aligned samples.
